thread.title: No. 14 Panthers hammer No. 9 San Antonio Wagner in Hoopfest
thread.title_full: No. 14 Panthers hammer No. 9 San Antonio Wagner in Hoopfest

author: EDWIN QUARLES The Lufkin Daily News
title: No. 14 Panthers hammer No. 9 San Antonio Wagner in Hoopfest
text:
In a battle of top 15 teams in Class 5A, Lufkin proved to be too much for San Antonio Wagner Monday evening in the third annual Pineywoods Hoopfest.
The Panthers, ranked No. 14 in Class 5A in the latest Texas Association of Basketball Coaches poll, built a 10-point lead early in the second quarter and never let Wagner, the No. 9 team in 5A, get any closer in a 67-40 win at the Panther Activity Center.
The Panthers had four players in double figures with Austin Brown leading the way with 18 points. Kevo Moore had 17, Tripp McManus had 13 and Jakevion Sanders added 12.
Wagner, featuring 6-foot-8 Tre Clark, a UT-Arlington commit, and 6-foot-9 sophomore Cam Crenshaw, only got a combined seven points from the two players.
“This group is super fun to coach, they’re super competitive and I really believe they think they can play with anybody,” Lufkin head coach J.T. McManus said.
“We’ve just got to keep doing things like we’ve been taught. We’ve got kids we’re trying to play and sometimes you take a step back and there’s things that we could do better. But when you play as hard as we do with the talent we have, you’re going to have some good results more often than not.
“Their big guy (Clark) got in a little foul trouble and probably couldn’t be as aggressive as he wanted to. But that’s some of what our kids do. I mean, we get after it, we frustrate people and that’s kind of our M.O.”
Lufkin never trailed, and the game was tied just once at 4-4.
A pair of Wagner turnovers led to easy layups for Austin Brown and Kevo Moore as Lufkin jumped ahead 4-0.
Wagner’s Clark got a dunk and a driving layup from Tyler Jackson tied the score at 4-4.
An 8-0 run by the Panthers included hitting six of eight free throws and a drive and bucket from Sanders to make it 12-4.
The T-Birds’ Jackson got a layup at the first-quarter buzzer to make it 12-6.
The Panthers got a pair of threes early in the second period with McManus and Moore each hitting from deep. A dunk from Brown and a layup for Cayden Burse off an assist from Moore made it 22-8.
Sanders scored on two more drives in the second period, and a late layup from Moore gave Lufkin a 31-16 halftime lead.
The Panthers picked things up offensively in the third period, outscoring Wagner 23-17 and hitting 10 of 13 from the free throw line. Brown was 8-for-8 from the line in the quarter.
Moore added six points in the period, and the Panthers built a 54-33 lead going into the fourth period.
The Panthers put the game away with a 12-1 run to start the fourth quarter. McManus had five points in the stretch, and Lufkin built its biggest lead to 32, 66-34.
The T-Birds scored six straight and the Panthers added a late free throw to make the final 67-40.
Cayden Burse added four points for Lufkin in the win, C.J. Burse had two and JaMarrien Williams added one.
Tyler Jackson led Wagner with 15 and Clark finished with five.
